metadata.task: Prepare the hospital for the next shift by organizing the reception desk, restocking essential supplies, parking all wheelchairs in the designated area, ensuring patient room doors are properly closed, and returning to the nurse station.

plan.goal: Complete the hospital shift preparation sequence: organize reception, restock supplies, park wheelchairs, close patient room doors, and return to the nurse station.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Organize the reception desk by arranging items into a tidy layout.
checkpoints.entry_state: Reception desk contains disorganized items (tables, chairs, serving counter, coffee machine, water dispenser, microwave, refrigerator).
checkpoints.exit_state: Reception desk items are arranged in a tidy, organized layout.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill ENV_014 allows arranging objects into a target layout; the reception desk requires organization.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Restock essential supplies in the pharmacy zone.
checkpoints.entry_state: Pharmacy storage shelves are low on essential medications and consumables.
checkpoints.exit_state: Pharmacy storage shelves are restocked with essential supplies.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 allows navigating to the named room 'pharmacy'.
Skill MAN_021 allows picking objects from a shelf; supplies are in the medical store.
Skill MOB_001 allows moving the robot to transport the held object.
Skill MAN_022 allows placing the held object onto the pharmacy shelf.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Park all wheelchairs in the designated wheelchair storage area.
checkpoints.entry_state: Wheelchairs are scattered throughout the hospital corridors and zones.
checkpoints.exit_state: All wheelchairs are parked in the designated wheelchair storage area.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_014 allows navigating to the pose of a detected object ('wheelchair').
Skill MAN_001 allows picking up the wheelchair using the parallel gripper.
Skill MOB_001 allows moving the robot while holding the wheelchair.
Skill MAN_002 allows placing the wheelchair in the designated storage area.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Ensure all patient room doors are properly closed.
checkpoints.exit_state: All patient room doors are closed.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 allows navigating to the named room 'general_ward'.
Skill MAN_014 allows closing a door using the manipulator.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the last patient room or corridor.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the nurse station.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 allows navigating to the named room 'nurse_station'.

constraints: Robot cannot climb stairs; must use elevators for floor transitions.
Robot has single arm only; cannot use two hands simultaneously.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: Reception desk organized, supplies restocked, wheelchairs parked, patient room doors closed, and robot returned to nurse station.
